At the northwestern tip of Mindanao is the generally mountainous [Zamboanga Peninsula](/wiki/Zamboanga_Peninsula_(geographical_region) "Zamboanga Peninsula (geographical region)"). The chain of mountain ranges in this region is called *[Zamboanga Cordilleras](/w/index.php?title=Zamboanga_Cordilleras&action=edit&redlink=1 "Zamboanga Cordilleras (page does not exist)")*, with the highest elevation at [Mount Dapi](/w/index.php?title=Mount_Dapi&action=edit&redlink=1 "Mount Dapi (page does not exist)"), which is 2,617 meters (8,586 ft) high.

The southern coastline is irregular, featuring two smaller peninsulas, the [Sibuguey](/w/index.php?title=Sibuguey_Peninsula&action=edit&redlink=1 "Sibuguey Peninsula (page does not exist)") and [Baganian](/w/index.php?title=Baganian_Peninsula&action=edit&redlink=1 "Baganian Peninsula (page does not exist)"), extending southward to the [Moro Gulf](/wiki/Moro_Gulf "Moro Gulf").[[51]](#cite_note-ThePhilippineIslandWorld-51)

To the north of the [Diwata Mountains](/w/index.php?title=Diwata_Mountains&action=edit&redlink=1 "Diwata Mountains (page does not exist)") at northeast Mindanao lie [Siargao](/wiki/Siargao "Siargao") island and the [Dinagat group of islands](/wiki/Dinagat_Islands "Dinagat Islands").[[51]](#cite_note-ThePhilippineIslandWorld-51)

Southwest of the Zamboanga Peninsula is the [Sulu Archipelago](/wiki/Sulu_Archipelago "Sulu Archipelago"), a chain of islands which comprise the smaller archipelago provinces of [Basilan](/wiki/Basilan "Basilan"), [Sulu](/wiki/Sulu "Sulu"), and [Tawi-Tawi](/wiki/Tawi-Tawi "Tawi-Tawi").[[51]](#cite_note-ThePhilippineIslandWorld-51)

Merkel had originally wanted to nominate Green politician [Marianne Birthler](/wiki/Marianne_Birthler "Marianne Birthler"), and as the CDU/CSU and the Greens control a majority in the Federal Convention, Birthler's election would have been secured. On 12 February 2017, Germany's 16th [Federal Convention](/wiki/Federal_Convention_(Germany) "Federal Convention (Germany)") elected Steinmeier President on the first ballot, with 931 votes out of a total of 1,260.
